title: Weird Loners
production_companies: Hanley ProductionsThe Detective Agency20th Century Fox Television
premise_summary: Weird Loners is an American sitcom that was created by Michael J. Weithorn. The 6-episode first season was ordered straight-to-series by the Fox network in 2014. The series is executive produced by Weithorn and Jake Kasdan. The series premiered on March 31, 2015.
